Overview of the Innow8 Stem Innovation Engineer Position

Innow8 has posted a professional opening for a Stem Innovation Engineer across multiple regions in Northern India. The role focuses on facilitating hands-on STEM learning, managing maker space operations, and guiding students in practical technologies such as robotics, coding, and IoT development.

According to the official job listing, the position involves visiting schools to teach robotics and mentor students in creative problem-solving and engineering projects. The responsibilities encompass developing student prototypes, coordinating lab activities with educational staff, managing ATAL Tinkering Labs or robotics spaces, and organizing workshops and innovation challenges.

Role Details and Requirements

  • Employer: Innow8
  • Role: Stem Innovation Engineer
  • Locations: Multiple locations across Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Delhi, specifically noted in cities including Chandigarh, Ghaziabad, Bulandshahr, Noida, Gurgaon, Meerut, Sangrur, and Mohali. The primary job duty involves visiting schools in these areas.
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Facilitate hands-on STEM learning through robotics, coding, design thinking, and engineering activities.
  • Design and implement Arduino and ESP32-based projects.
  • Manage lab operations, equipment safety, and inventory in spaces like ATAL Tinkering Labs.
  • Coordinate with teachers, volunteers, and school leadership.

Practical Implications and How to Verify

For educators, engineers, or professionals interested in educational technology and maker space management, this listing highlights active engagement in school-based STEM programs across Northern India. Applicants should note that geographical flexibility is required due to the multi-city visiting nature of the role.

Readers can independently review the complete, unedited posting details, check for updates, and submit applications directly through the official [LinkedIn Job Listing](https://in.linkedin.com/jobs/view/stem-innovation-engineer-in-chandigarh-ghaziabad-uttar-pradesh-bulandshahr-noida-punjab-gurgaon-meerut-sangrur-mohali-at-innow8-4472659090).
